_meta.datasheet_section: Table 2-1 Pin-out Description, Figure 2-1; §23.5 Unused Pins; Fig 24-1 outline, Fig 24-3 land pattern; §1.9.3 TCXO, Table 6-65
_meta.notes: DS numbers the exposed pad as pin 0; footprint uses 33. DS Table 2-1 has typo 'DI010' for pin 8. VTCXO 1.6-3.3 V programmable, ILTCXO 4 mA max, VDDop > VTCXO + 0.2 V. TCXO into XTA: clipped sine 0.4-1.2 Vpp via 10 pF + 220 Ω.
